description: A test suite for protocol operations, cryptographic functions, and key generation in a JavaScript project using Mocha and Chai. The tests verify key creation, encryption/decryption, and key parameter handling.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: Represents an encrypted payload with necessary cryptographic properties, used for encryption and decryption operations.

methods.name: createApplicationWithRealCrypto
methods.description: Creates an application instance configured to use real cryptographic functions.

methods.name: initializeApplication
methods.description: Initializes the application, possibly setting up necessary parameters or state.

methods.name: safeDeinit
methods.description: Safely deinitializes or cleans up the application instance.

methods.name: createKeyParams
methods.description: Creates key parameters for cryptographic operations based on specified options.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Generates a root cryptographic key given identifier, password, and key derivation origin.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes a root key from existing key parameters and password.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random key of specified length.

methods.name: createItemsKey
methods.description: Creates an items encryption key used for encrypting data items.

methods.name: generateEncryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Encrypts payload data and generates parameters including encryption metadata.

methods.name: generateDecryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted parameters and retrieves original payload.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string using the provided key.

methods.name: decryptString
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string using the provided key.
